<thought>The spectrum shows a clear M+2 peak at ~24 % of the base peak, matching the characteristic 3:1 intensity ratio of 35Cl/37Cl. No 1:1 M+2 pattern (bromine) or the much smaller ~4 % M+2 (sulfur) is observed. Thus chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
